name: Stripe
description: Stripe's remote MCP server works with an API key, which is its whole permission boundary: use a restricted key, stored in the credential vault. It is best treated as read-mostly, since a write-capable key can move real money.

probe.note: 401 'missing_api_key'; the challenge points at mcp.stripe.com's protected-resource document, but the error body asks for an API key.
